critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the 'Main cabin window row' primitive along the fuselage Z-axis; offset the new set by 1.5x the current radius to create two distinct rows (upper and lower decks). Adjust the spacing of both rows from a uniform distribution to a variable pattern, introducing 20% larger gaps at intervals corresponding to the door placements.

discrepancies.reference: Prominent front boarding doors located near the cockpit.
